personal_details.name: Md. Zahid Hasan

personal_details.bio: Software engineer with 3+ years of experience delivering responsive, user-centric interfaces using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Comfortable with backend development (Node.js, Express.js) and cross-functional collaboration to ship reliable features.
about_paragraphs: I’ve spent over three years building scalable, maintainable interfaces for platforms like CartUp and Foodi, often owning features end-to-end from UI to integratons.
I focus on clean JavaScript/TypeScript, API integrations, and performance optimizations (SSR, code splitting, lazy loading) to keep experiences fast.
Beyond coding, I enjoy filmmaking and partnering with design, QA, and backend teams to ensure dependable releases.
